stops.name: Fiume Biedano
stops.detail: The area is therefore characterized by large tuff valleys, covered with dense vegetation, where two main watercourses flow: the Biedano River and the Vesca River.

stops.name: Centro Visite
stops.detail: In addition to the operational structures (Offices, Visitor Centre and naturalistic museum, in Viale IV Novembre), the protected area has a Hostel and a Guest House in the medieval village.

days.title: Archeology and History of San Giuliano
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tomba del Cervo
stops.detail: This resulted in new life for the humbler inhabitants, evidenced by the richness of some funerary items belonging to large family groups, most notably that of the Tomb of the Deer, characterized by the large semi-cube chamber, and the Thanzinas tombs, intended to house dozens of sarcophagi belonging to the same family.

stops.name: San Giuliano
stops.detail: In search of refuge, the inhabitants of these places took a stand on the San Giuliano height, where high tuff defensive walls can be observed.

stops.name: Via Clodia
stops.detail: After the conquest, the Romans saw to the expansion and modernization of the Etruscan paths; in particular, the remains of the Via Clodia, an indispensable connection route between Rome and Etruria, are found in the park.
